label: Trail Names
description: Real-time trail name display with directional arrows, proximity bar, difficulty symbols, and beep+flash alerts. Downloads trail data from OpenStreetMap for offline use during rides. Works on K2 and K3.
releaseNotes: v1.5 - K3 support, Overpass server fallback, 30 mile radius, red proximity bar, beep toggle fix. Note: On first install, open the app and tap Download Trails. If GPS is not ready, close the app and reopen it, then tap Download again.
